title: ActionPlanTemplateItem - Data API
description: Represents the instance of an item on an action plan template version. This object is available in API version 44.0 and later.

ActionPlanTemplateVersionId.description: The version of the action plan template this item is for.

DisplayOrder.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DisplayOrder.description: The order in which this item is displayed within the action plan template version.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Indicates whether the task created from this template item is active. The default value is false.

IsLocked.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsLocked.description: Indicates whether this action plan template item is locked or not. The default value is false.

IsRequired.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsRequired.description: Indicates whether the task created from this template item is required. The default value is false.

ItemEntityType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ItemEntityType.description: The type of action plan template item entity.. Possible values are: Document Checklist Item Event—This value is available in API version 63.0. RecordAction Task

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user referenced this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user viewed this record.

MayEdit.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
MayEdit.description: Indicates whether this action plan template item can be edited or not. The default value is false.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Sort, idLookup, Update
Name.description: The unique identifier for this action plan template item record.

UniqueName.description: The unique name for this action plan template item. This field is unique within your organization.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **ActionPlanTemplateItemChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
- **ActionPlanTemplateItemFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **ActionPlanTemplateItemHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **ActionPlanTemplateItemOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **ActionPlanTemplateItemShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
